full_judgment:
2. Appellants are the Deputy General Manger (Admn) and Assistant General Manager (Admn) of the Milk Producers' Union which was formed for the purpose of dairy farm and other installations for production and sale of milk products. General Manager is the Chief executive and it is managed by Managing Committee and controlled by the Registrar of Co-Operative Societies of the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. Respondent is a registered Trade Union under the Industrial Relation Ordinance, 1969. 

 11. M.L.O.19 may be considered. It was promulgated on 25th May, 1982. Paragraph 2 provides" Any person aggrieved by any decision other than an award of a Labour Court, delivered before or after the commencement of the Order, may within ninety days from the date of delivery of the decision, file a petition for revision of the decision to the Zonal Martial Law Administrator within whose jurisdiction the decision is delivered and the decision of the Zonal Martial Law Administrator on such petition shall, subject to approval of the Chief Martial Law Administrator, be final and binding upon the parties concerned.
